Offline / Local Mode

Advanced: Full Firebase Web Config (Optional)
🚀 How Real-Time Cloud Sync Works:
1. Create a free Firebase project at console.firebase.google.com (Free Spark plan, 0 cost).
2. Create a Realtime Database, set rules to {".read": true, ".write": true}, and paste the URL above.
3. As marshals record match scores, bracket outcomes sync live to phones and stadium screens with zero reloads in <100ms!
